query:
SELECT invariant, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(success) as fixed
FROM supervisor_audit 
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH)
GROUP BY invariant ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15;
